description: The maintained single-binary successor to the retiring mgc — every MSP-relevant Microsoft Graph surface, plus an offline store that finds wasted licenses, privileged-access risks, and stale devices no single API call can.

novel_features.name: License waste finder
novel_features.description: Surfaces every tenant SKU where you are paying for more seats than you use, ranked by unused seats.

novel_features.name: Licensed-orphan audit
novel_features.description: Lists disabled and guest accounts that still hold paid SKUs — licenses you are paying for but nobody is using.

novel_features.name: Privileged-access audit
novel_features.description: Lists every holder of a privileged directory role with the role name, account-enabled state, and guest/disabled risk flags.

novel_features.name: Fresh-alert triage window
novel_features.description: Counts the open security alerts created in a recent time window, grouped by severity and detection source.

novel_features.name: Intune compliance drift
novel_features.description: Flags Intune devices that are non-compliant, unencrypted, or have not checked in within a time window, attributed to their assigned user.

novel_features.name: Whole-tenant posture rollup
novel_features.description: One agent-readable summary of the tenant: user and guest counts, license waste, admin count, open high-severity alerts, and non-compliant device count.

novel_features.name: License reassignment map
novel_features.description: Lists every user consuming a specific SKU, with account-enabled state and guest flags, so you can plan seat reclamation and reassignment.

novel_features.name: Group sprawl audit
novel_features.description: Flags ownerless, empty, and guest-heavy groups across the tenant in one pass.

novel_features.name: Third-party app consent audit
novel_features.description: Inventories every non-Microsoft enterprise application consented into the tenant and the access it holds, risk-ranked with over-privileged, admin-consented, privilege-escalation and user-consented flags.

novel_features.name: Meeting transcript list (own tenant)
novel_features.description: Lists the transcripts of one Teams meeting the signed-in user can already open, in the credential's own tenant only.

novel_features.name: Meeting transcript download (own tenant)
novel_features.description: Downloads one Teams meeting transcript as WebVTT to stdout or a named file, in the credential's own tenant only; nothing is kept on disk by the CLI.

novel_features.name: All transcripts for one organizer (own tenant)
novel_features.description: Lists every transcript from the meetings one user organized, in the credential's own tenant only (Graph offers this to application tokens only, behind an explicit opt-in).
